Serving over 200M customers globally, our Customer Service (CS) organization is at the forefront of shaping how customers experience Amazon. jobs.description: Job Title: Senior Combat Designer - Raven - Middleton, WI Requisition ID: R028119 Job Description: Your Mission Your mission is to develop, implement, and refine combat systems that will be enjoyed by millions of players worldwide in Call of Duty: Warzone. Reporting to the Associate Design Director, you will balance and implement various combat systems including weapons, functional equipment, kill streaks and perks. Prior experience working on a games-as-a-service product. FPS experience. Knowledge & Skills Understanding of Call of Duty Warzone including systems, modes and gameplay. Experience mentoring junior designers. Knowledge & Skills. Extensive knowledge and understanding of the F2P games space Profound understanding of the Call of Duty franchise and Warzone. LOCATION: TORONTO (HYBRID)

COMPANY OVERVIEW:

The Kitchen brings together a range of disciplines and capabilities. It’s a team of creatives, producers, data analysts and social experts working together to deliver remarkable ideas that live in a variety of mediums, from everything from social to TV. This team moves at the speed of culture. It is built to respond to trends and events as they happen, coming up with the ideas that transcend social media to capture the spirit of the moment, earn media impressions, and get the country talking.

Are you ready to join an award-ambitious team that's making waves in the advertising industry? Our incredible team has been recognized internationally by industry giants like Cannes, One Show and was named Campaign's Global In-House Agency of The Year, further solidifying our position as a leader in the industry. Join us and be a part of something truly special, a team that's dedicated to creating ground-breaking work and pushing limits.

At The Kitchen, we're not just looking for individuals who want to be a part of the advertising industry, we're looking for trailblazers who are ready to lead the way to the next big thing. We want individuals who are passionate about producing award-winning work and have an innate drive to their craft and are eager to generate innovative ideas both within and outside of the brief.

ROLE OVERVIEW:

In this role as a Social Copywriter, you are part of an agile social team that is constantly looking for inspiration in the world, culture, and on the internet to find the next opportunity for a breakthrough social content. You are the voice of your brands online and therefore are responsible for shaping the brands’ personalities every day with the words and ideas you create for social. You have a deep understanding of your audience, and your brands’ passion points to be able to identify opportunities for social content. You have the creative ability to craft the clever responses, humorous posts and meaningful brands act on social that define how your brand comes to life.

You will interface with the community every day, through the lens of earning attention and starting a conversation. You’ll collaborate with a content creator and social media manager to ideate and create content for social, and you’ll work with an Art Director/Copywriter team to elevate great social ideas into brand acts and elevated content. You help create and steward the playbooks that define the personality of these brands, from their passion points to their tone of voice. You will help ensure that each brand lives up to its unique place in a constantly evolving dynamic world of social media.

Your work will make a meaningful impact with a multi-talented team in North America (Toronto & Chicago) that blurs the lines of what advertising can be in today’s always-on, socially connected industry.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES:

• SOCIAL COPYWRITING: You’re a versatile writer who will write a range (from funny to inspiring) content for social and digital channels, helping to build consumer love for your brand and establish cultural relevance
• CONTENT CREATION: You will write, edit and publish engaging posts for various social networks
• SOCIAL OPTIMIZATION: You will optimize social media posts (language, tone, message) based on our target audience’s behaviours and established brand tone and voice
• COLLABORATION: You will work with a Content Creator on images and videos to complement text, and co-create a wide range of social post types and concepts
• BRAND PRESENCE CREATION: You’ll manage/update social media pages, profiles with on-tone descriptions and news
• AD COPYWRITING: You will coordinate with internal teams to create advertising concepts
• COMMUNITY MANAGEMENT: You’ll respond to questions and comments on our social media pages in a timely and accurate manner or transfer to the social care or escalations team for customer service-related issues

EXPERIENCE & SKILLS

• 1+ years of experience in a social team or creative department in a related role
• Advertising portfolio required
• A proven track record of writing for brands with a significant following, ideally for a CPG or lifestyle brand
• A university or college diploma in marketing, advertising, or a related field is preferred
• A history of being able to work with creative teams and strategists, providing expertise and influencing the brand’s strategy
• A love and deep understanding of social culture and trends
• Experience with a social media management platform (i.e. Sprout, Sprinklr, Khoros) is required
• Excellent presentation skills and communication skills in a group environment
• A passion for food and food marketing
• A desire to do award-winning, internationally recognized work

The anticipated annual base salary range for this position is $57,000–$65,000. jobs.description: Are you curious about what makes talent programs truly effective? The Amazon Web Services (AWS) Data Center Learning (DCL) team is looking for a Ready to Hire Evaluation Analyst to join our growing evaluation team within Learning Operations. In this role, you will assess the effectiveness of Data Center Learning programs across multiple geographies, turning raw data into actionable insights that shape where we invest and how we grow our data center workforce. This is a new and rapidly expanding area for DCL — and your work will shift the organization from measuring activity volume to measuring real impact and conversion rates. You will partner with colleagues across the builder readiness continuum, customer success, and Talent Acquisition (TA) teams to ensure our programs are preparing the right candidates for our data centers worldwide. Key job responsibilities - Manage the end-to-end evaluation program for Data Center Learning programs, defining success metrics, tracking progress, and delivering detailed analysis reports that recommend where to invest across geographies. - Baseline current program performance, identify gaps, and surface data-driven recommendations to stakeholders who define pipeline identification strategies, proactively mitigating risks to program timelines and outcomes. - Use Amazon's internal analytics tools and generative AI capabilities to build insights, automate reporting, and continuously improve evaluation methods. - Partner with cross-functional stakeholders including customer success, TA, and builder readiness teams to align evaluation findings with broader workforce development goals and drive measurable improvements in conversion rates. - Communicate findings and trade-off recommendations clearly to program leaders and senior stakeholders, clearing blockers and driving timely decisions that keep improvement efforts on track. A day in the life You will start your day reviewing the latest data from ongoing program evaluations, identifying trends and areas that need attention. From there, you will move into collaborative sessions with TA partners and builder readiness stakeholders to discuss findings and align on next steps. Much of your week balances independent, heads-down analysis work with cross-team meetings where you present recommendations and help shape investment decisions. You operate proactively, setting the evaluation roadmap rather than reacting to requests, and you have the autonomy to define what good performance looks like for the programs you assess. About the team The Data Center Learning team sits within AWS Infrastructure Services and is dedicated to developing a world-class data center workforce. We create learning experiences for new hires, build career development paths to grow internal talent, and experiment with new technology to improve how adults learn in a data center environment. Our evaluation function is young and growing fast — you will help shape a capability that is rare across the industry and central to how we prove and improve the value of our programs. You will be part of an inclusive, collaborative group that values independent thinking and gives you room to make the role your own as the team evolves. Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness. Mentorship & Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional. Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Technology - Information Security

Are you interested in building capabilities that enable the organization with innovation, speed, agility, scalability and efficiency? The Global Technology team takes great pride in our culture where digital transformation is built into our DNA. When you join our organization, you will unlock an exciting and impactful career while growing your skills and advancing your profession at one of the world's leading financial services institutions.

Your Team & Role

As a Lead, Network Security Analyst within the Network Security Strategy & Analysis team, within the ISO Infrastructure Security team, you will serve as a senior individual contributor focused on assessing enterprise network security capabilities, identifying risk and technical debt, and developing actionable strategies for Zero Trust, network segmentation, network access control, and network security modernization. You will partner with Network Engineering, Network Security Operations, Infrastructure, Cloud, Identity, Architecture, and other security teams to translate analysis into prioritized roadmaps and measurable risk reduction. You will explain difficult concepts, influence stakeholders, and work on extremely complex problems where analysis of situations or data requires evaluation of risk, controls, architecture, and business impact.

This role does not own day-to-day administration or operations of network security platforms; instead, this team will use analysis to drive environmental hardening and risk reduction. Success requires technical depth, strategic thinking, strong analytical judgment, and the ability to lead work through influence across multiple teams.

Here Is What You Can Expect on a Typical Day

•

Lead complex current-state analysis/assessments of network security architecture, controls, processes, and technical debt across campus, data center, cloud, and remote-access environments.

•

Develop strategic recommendations, target-state architectures, transition roadmaps, and prioritized risk-reduction plans for Zero Trust networking, segmentation, NAC, ZTNA, firewall, proxy, and related capabilities.

•

Analyze architecture, configuration, telemetry, asset, vulnerability, and control data to identify material risks, systemic gaps, and opportunities to harden the environment.

•

Functionally lead workstreams and provide technical guidance to less-experienced team members without direct people-management responsibility.

•

Partner with operational and engineering teams that own the technologies to validate findings, define remediation approaches, establish milestones, and drive agreed actions to completion.

•

Participate in security architecture and design reviews, documenting requirements, assumptions, risks, compensating controls, and recommended decisions.

•

Contribute to reusable reference architectures, security patterns, engineering requirements, decision frameworks, and assessment methods aligned to enterprise standards.

•

Communicate complex network security risks and tradeoffs to technical teams, business stakeholders, and senior leaders using concise, evidence-based recommendations.

•

Define outcome-oriented metrics and contribute to executive reporting that demonstrates risk reduction, control maturity, roadmap progress, and technical-debt retirement.

•

Evaluate emerging technologies and industry practices and recommend where they should influence the network security strategy.

•

Be the network security subject matter expert within the ISO Infrastructure Security Team.

The Skills & Expertise You Bring

•

Bachelor of Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or equivalent experience in related fields.

•

Advanced network security engineering, architecture, advisory, or strategy experience in a large and complex enterprise environment.

•

Ability to independently structure ambiguous problems, develop analysis plans, evaluate alternatives, and deliver clear recommendations with minimal guidance.

•

Ability to functionally lead complex work, mentor others, and effectively leverage diverse ideas, experiences, and perspectives.

•

Strong business insight and the ability to balance security risk, operational feasibility, customer impact, cost, and delivery constraints.

•

Experience with agile delivery or program-management methods and cross-functional execution.

•

Excellent problem solving, written communication, executive presentation, facilitation, and collaboration skills.

Advanced Experience and/or Expertise with Several of the Following

•

Enterprise network architecture and security controls across campus, branch, data center, cloud, internet edge, and remote-access environments.

•

Firewalls, secure web gateways, proxies, ZTNA, VPN, DNS security, WAF, load balancers, and network detection capabilities, including platforms such as Check Point, Cisco, and Zscaler.

•

Zero Trust principles, NIST SP 800-207, identity-aware access, least privilege, continuous verification, and policy-based access models.

•

Network segmentation and microsegmentation strategies, trust-zone design, application dependency analysis, and east-west traffic controls.

•

NAC strategy and design, including device discovery, profiling, authentication, authorization, 802.1X, exception handling, and phased enterprise adoption.

•

Security architecture reviews, threat modeling, risk assessments, control design, compensating controls, and remediation planning.

•

Information Security policies, standards, procedures, engineering specifications, NIST frameworks, ISO 27000 standards, NIST 800-53, and CIS Controls.

•

Security analytics using SIEM, network telemetry, configuration data, asset inventories, vulnerability data, and CMDB/IPAM sources to identify and quantify risk.

•

Metrics, KRIs, KPIs, maturity assessments, business cases, and multi-year security roadmaps.

Preferred Qualifications

•

CISSP, CCSP, CISM, SANS GIAC, or comparable security certification.

•

Advanced network or security certifications from Cisco, Check Point, Zscaler, GIAC, or equivalent providers.

•

Experience driving large-scale Zero Trust, segmentation, NAC, firewall modernization, or ZTNA transformation programs.

You'll Love Working Here Because You Can

Join a team and culture where your voice matters and where your work improves security outcomes. As you put your skills to use, we will help you expand both your technical and leadership capabilities through meaningful work and continuous learning.

• Identify and log localization bugs—ranging from translation issues to UI problems—using detailed, reproducible steps
• Ensure consistency in spelling, grammar, terminology, tone, variable usage, and cultural appropriateness
• Amend or propose edits and translations to objective linguistic issues directly in text management systems
• Analyze reported issues to identify potential root causes and flag patterns that may indicate systemic localization or i18n risks.
• Flag localization risks early in the development cycle, including potential issues with variables, UI constraints, or source text clarity

• Follow documented test plans and contribute to test case creation and improvement

• Stay current on key project terminology and serve as a resource for your native language(s)

• Native fluency in your supported language Russian
• Strong written and verbal English communication skills
• Ideally experience in QA (functional QA, localization QA, or related testing roles), with demonstrated linguistic proficiency in the supported language.
• Experience with game consoles, mobile platforms, or game development terminology

• Familiarity with QA and localization workflows, including bug logging and test execution
• Knowledge of JIRA, bug tracking platforms, or text management systems

• Proactive, detail-oriented, and organized, with a collaborative mindset
• Ability to work under deadlines, follow instructions, and ask questions when needed
• Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience required
• Passion for video games and cross-cultural storytelling
• Exposure to localization or CAT tools (e.g., Trados, MemoQ, XLOC)
• Experience working with or overseeing external QA partners or freelance reviewers
• ISTQB certification or equivalent QA accreditation
• Knowledge of regional age rating standards, particularly in supported territories

WHY JOIN US?

As an LQA Analyst I, you’ll begin your journey at the heart of 2K’s localization efforts—helping ensure our games are clear, culturally relevant, and enjoyable for players around the world. You’ll build foundational skills in linguistic QA within a collaborative, multilingual environment, while gaining hands-on experience with the tools, processes, and workflows that support global game development.
